bullets.id: Emas turun 1,34% ke $4.108,8 pada Rabu, terendah dalam sekitar sebulan, setelah sempat menembus di bawah $4.100. Risalah FOMC September menunjukkan seluruh pejabat mendukung kenaikan suku bunga September dan sebagian besar memperkirakan satu kenaikan lagi sebelum akhir tahun. Kamis pagi emas pulih 0,63% ke sekitar $4.137.
bullets.en: Gold fell 1.34% to $4,108.8 on Wednesday, its lowest in about a month, after briefly breaking below $4,100. The September FOMC minutes showed every official backed the September rate hike and most expect one more hike before year-end. On Thursday morning gold recovered 0.63% to about $4,137.

bullets.id: Yield 10 tahun sempat ke 5,32%, level yang terakhir terlihat pada 2002, lalu bertahan di sekitar 5,31%. Indeks dolar di sekitar 102,2, dekat level terkuat sejak awal 2025, dan Brent naik ke sekitar $102. Pasar memperkirakan Fed menahan suku bunga Oktober, tetapi peluang kenaikan Desember sekitar 78%. Emas turun hampir 6% sebulan dan sekitar 26% di bawah rekor Januari $5.608.
bullets.en: The 10-year yield touched 5.32%, a level last seen in 2002, then held near 5.31%. The dollar index is around 102.2, near its strongest since early 2025, and Brent rose to about $102. Markets expect the Fed to hold in October, but put the odds of a December hike at about 78%. Gold is down almost 6% on the month and about 26% below its January record of $5,608.

bullets.id: $4.100 kini menjadi garis pertahanan utama, dengan zona $4.000–4.020 di bawahnya. Di atas, resistance ada di $4.180–4.190. Kamis malam WIB ada data klaim pengangguran AS, lalu sentimen konsumen pada Jumat. Rapat Fed berikutnya pada 28 Oktober.
bullets.en: $4,100 is now the main line of defense, with the $4,000–4,020 zone below it. Above, resistance sits at $4,180–4,190. US jobless claims are due Thursday evening WIB, then consumer sentiment on Friday. The next Fed meeting is on October 28.

bullets.id: Antam turun Rp15.000 ke Rp2.565.000/gram dan buyback turun Rp25.000 ke Rp2.366.000, sehingga spread melebar ke Rp199.000 (sekitar 7,8%). Galeri24 Rp2.516.000 (buyback Rp2.368.000) dan UBS Rp2.539.000 (buyback Rp2.343.000). Kepemilikan ETF SPDR Gold naik ke 1.056,27 ton per 5 Oktober dari 1.042,36 ton akhir Agustus, tanda pembelian saat harga turun.
bullets.en: Antam fell Rp15,000 to Rp2,565,000/gram and buyback fell Rp25,000 to Rp2,366,000, widening the spread to Rp199,000 (about 7.8%). Galeri24 is at Rp2,516,000 (buyback Rp2,368,000) and UBS at Rp2,539,000 (buyback Rp2,343,000). SPDR Gold ETF holdings rose to 1,056.27 tonnes on October 5 from 1,042.36 tonnes at end-August, a sign of dip-buying.
